nodes.question: What role does urbanization play in environmental determinants according to the paragraph?
nodes.answer: Urbanization is highlighted as a significant environmental determinant that contributes to environmental pollution through the increased demand for energy-intensive products.

nodes.label: Management
nodes.question: Why have policymakers focused on the connection between urbanization and environmental quality?
nodes.answer: Policymakers have focused on this connection due to the positive and negative externalities of urbanization on sustainability, aiming to provide better solutions to address environmental stress.
